question: Does the untouched OFF-arm e2.world_forward head READ ITS ACTION at alpha_world 0.9 on a LIVE reset-on-done battery, on all 3 seeds -- i.e. does the same-rows action-shuffle readiness form return 'ready' (ratio > 1.0 AND skill > 0.0 vs the copy-the-input predictor)?
decisive_readout: action_sensitivity_gate same-rows action_shuffle readiness verdict (ratio = sum(per_row_se_swap_mean)/sum(per_row_se_true), floor 1.0; skill = skill_vs_identity, floor 0.0)
method_note: Derived in closed form from V3-EXQ-1082's landed ARM_OFF cells (alpha_world 0.9, LIVE reset-on-done battery, 512 rows, 5 distinct actions, 0 post-death rows per cell). The gate's shuffle ratio is sum(e_shuffled)/sum(e_true) under a derangement of the action column; because the battery's actions are i.i.d. uniform over 5, that derangement draws each row's replacement ~uniformly from the 4 alternatives and therefore ESTIMATES sum(per_row_se_swap_mean)/sum(per_row_se_true) = S/T, which 1082 stores per row for every ARM_OFF cell. S/T is also exactly (1+d_act)/(1-d_act), since d_act := (S-T)/(S+T) -- so the ratio clause is algebraically equivalent to d_act > 0. Verified empirically in the V3-EXQ-1092 dry run: the 16-draw derangement mean tracks S/T within ~1% in every cell (e.g. 2.0473 vs 2.0371, 1.5397 vs 1.5512). skill_vs_identity is read directly from 1082. ZERO new compute.
notes: GOV-REUSE-1 consumer-half result. Settles the recoverable half of the SD-PP-B5 inverted-map probe (chip-20260924-sdppb5-inverted-map-probe) at zero compute, per USER decision '(2) then (1)' on chip-20260924-sdppb5-invmap-loadbearing-recoverable (rec-20260924-5812c302). ANSWER: yes on 3/3 seeds -- S/T 2.0371/1.5512/1.5858 all > 1.0, skill +0.3486/+0.2194/+0.2149 all > 0.0, d_act CI lower bound > 0 on 3/3 (0.3230/0.2026/0.2156). Supporting context from the same source: the ridge positive control reads its action on 3/3; the UNTRAINED head's d_act sits at the analytic null (0.0022 / -0.0016 / 0.0005), which is the empirical floor; model_r2 0.5569/0.4788/0.4865 is recorded beside every persistence-relative number per the 1082 design. SCOPE -- what this does NOT answer: the INVERTED-ACTION-MAP (cross-battery) ratio and its action-blind null remain unmeasured at every alpha on a live battery, because 1082 collected no inverted-map battery at all; that is the genuinely new quantity and is what V3-EXQ-1092 is being re-pointed at (option B). This artifact exists because V3-EXQ-1092 as first written would have re-derived exactly the numbers above -- its alpha-0.9 arm reproduced 1082's ARM_OFF bit-for-bit (identical battery_hash, d_act equal to 17 digits, identical per-row errors). See GFLAG-0475 and REE_assembly evidence/planning/sdppb5_inverted_map_ratio_criterion_aliasing_staged_20260924.md.
